main_text.p: Explicandus erat abusus. Sed hoc etiam, vti cætera, diuinan-dum reliquit: & quod non erat, æque ac si effet, in suspicionem suo silentio maligne admodum vocauit. Qui enim abusus non expressus, neque palam factus excusari, aut defendi potest?

Et plane ex Notis post Octauam Synodum contra Photium constat, Stylianum Neocæsariensem a Photio promotum post varios de sua ordinatione apud Romanos Pontifices conatus, seductum a Photianis a Pontificia auctoritate desciuisse, scripsisseque de ea ad Ioannem Nonum, cuius ad dicta Styliani extat responsum, in quo confirmat Prædecessorum suorum acta omnia contra Photium, quæ se sequi firmissime asseuerat. Hinc colligitur a Nicolao Primo ad ipsum Ioannem omnes illos Pontifices Photium excommunicasse, & eius Ordinationes improbasse. En verba; Ἐπ̓ τῆς ἱσέως, ὅτι ὁ Μάπας ὁ Μητροπολίτης Νεοκαισαρείας ὁ Στυλιανὸς μὴ τὸ ἀξιῶ[?] τὴν ἐπιτολὴν τὰ Πάπα Φωτίου τὴν ἀνέφερτον[?], καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τοῖς ἐπιστολαῖς[?], ἐπὶ χρόνων ἀπάρχων[?] καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὁδὸν τῆς ἀληθείας ἐπὶ τὰ ἐναντία τῆς διδαχῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων, καὶ ἐπράξε πρὸς τὴν Ῥώμην αὐτὸς μετὰ ταῦτα περιφρονήσας ἐκ τῶν ἐπιθύμιν[?] χειροτονίαν[?]

page.notes: The Greek paragraph is set in small type and is only partly legible on the scan; the Greek readings are best effort and carry [?] where letters are doubtful. The catchword and the final Greek word on the last line are heavily abraded. The "D 3" signature is at the foot centre. The reference letters and line-end hyphenation are as far as visible; no marginal notes appear on this page.
